The five-completed-exploration repetition check avoided every selected candidate boundary from Runs 203, 206, 207, 208 and 209. Placements are candidate-specific hypotheses, not a boundary-distribution quota.

Nine leads survived because each has an exact title, concrete current/emerging/catalogue source context, a constitution-relevant belonging hypothesis and a lawful placement question; no list slot was padded.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
